item.title: Senate Proposes Amendment to Increase Federal Government’s Revenue Share
item.description: The Nigerian Senate is seeking to amend the 1999 Constitution to increase the Federal Government’s share of revenue from the Federation Account (FAAC). Lawmakers argue that the current revenue allocation formula no longer reflects the scale of responsibilities held by the central government.Under the existing system, the Federal Government receives 52.68% of federation revenue, the 36 states share 26.72%, while the 774 local government councils receive 20.60%. item.title: Atlético Madrid unveils Super Eagles winger Ademola Lookman following €40m transfer
item.description: Nigerian international Ademola Lookman has officially joined Spanish giants Atlético Madrid following his €40 million transfer from Italian club Atalanta.
